facts: Parties: Eskdale Robotics Ltd (Buyer), Holloway Robotics Ltd (Seller); the Company is Merrion Energy plc.
This Agreement is dated 3 July 2026; Closing is scheduled for 29 August 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 8.4 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 12% of the Purchase Price, being $6,750,000. The Purchase Price is $45,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $6,500,000, capped at $3,000,000.
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.

Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Redcliffe Retail Group plc.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $7,300,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $2,200,000.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 60 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
